description.value:
Frequency once per character level

Requirement All your installed cyber-augments are Licensed.

You know this wiring better than the counter clerk who sold it to you. In place of the standard Licensed recalibration — a week of downtime and 10× a current-band augment's price — you shave 1 point of Drift with a single day of focused self-maintenance and no cost in credits. The all-Licensed requirement still applies: one Restricted or Black Market augment in you and even you won't touch the calibration.
